name: Hong-Wei Electrical Industry & Co., Ltd.
summary: Hong-Wei Electrical Industry & Co., Ltd. is a specialist in end-to-end vertical transportation solutions, managing everything from the conceptual design and manufacturing to the sales, upkeep, and servicing of various elevator systems. The company operates extensively both within Taiwan and across global markets. Its extensive product range features diverse options for freight elevators, including those with unique opening mechanisms, advanced driving systems, and other specialized configurations. For passenger transport, Hong-Wei provides a wide selection of elevators such as standard opening types, various drive system options, units with custom interior décor, models specifically designed for hospital beds, and scenic panoramic elevators. Additionally, their offerings extend to escalators and automated conveyor systems. Founded in 1968, Hong-Wei Electrical Industry & Co., Ltd. maintains its primary corporate office in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
